channel.title: The Augusta Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Augusta Press (theaugustapress.com)

item.title: Segundo Oliva Pinto takes one-stroke lead at Latin America Amateur
item.description: Argentina’s Segundo Oliva Pinto fired a six-under 64 Saturday to grab a one-stroke lead entering the final round of the 2026 Latin America Amateur (LAAC) at Lima Golf Club.

item.title: Grovetown package theft report reflects broader trend of empty iPhone deliveries
item.description: The Columbia County Sheriff’s Office is investigating a felony larceny after a resident reported receiving a FedEx package that appeared to have been tampered with and was missing its contents.

item.title: Sheriff: Child’s death on Aiken property ruled accidental, no charges filed
item.description: Authorities determined the New Year’s Eve death of 5-year-old Merinn Purcell on her family’s Aiken property was a tragic accident, and no charges will be filed.

item.title: Robbery investigation leads to SWAT response in South Augusta
item.description: A robbery reported Saturday afternoon led to a large law enforcement presence in south Augusta, according to Chief of Staff Lewis Blanchard.

item.title: Calendar of events: MLK Day of Service, meetings and more
item.description: Check out what's happening in the CSRA.

item.title: Senate bill would hold down property tax increases that fund Georgia schools
item.description: Tax increases on Georgia homeowners could be limited to the inflation rate — including taxes for education after most school systems decided against capping property tax hikes last year.

item.title: SRNS, Enercon complete design review for training center tied to plutonium facility
item.description: Savannah River Nuclear Solutions (SRNS) and subcontractor Enercon completed the Formal Design Review in December for the High-Fidelity Training and Operations Center, a subproject supporting the Savannah River Plutonium Processing Facility.

item.title: Tri-college MLK celebration brings Augusta leaders and students together at Paine College
item.description: Augusta leaders and students gathered at Paine College for the annual tri-college MLK celebration, featuring remarks from Mayor Garnett Johnson and keynote speaker Lamell McMorris.

item.title: Community vigorously opposes data center development in lengthy Planning Commission hearing
item.description: The Columbia County Planning Commission meeting which commissioners voted to recommend approval for three rezoning requests making way for data center lasted for nearly five hours.

item.title: Two wanted after Augusta victim lured from ATM in Saturday robbery
item.description: Two suspects wanted in a Saturday armed robbery are believed to have slipped away as a SWAT team was responding to a home connected to the case, according to investigators.
